facts.text: The image is a composite creature reference sheet: one large hero panel at the top and six smaller labeled panels below, arranged in two rows.

The main panel shows a massive dark charcoal-black dragon with armor-like scales, a long horned skull, dorsal spines, large membrane wings, four clawed legs, and a long tail; it stands on wet rocky terrain with its wings spread and head lowered.
The setting is a dark, misty volcanic landscape with jagged rock formations, shallow reflective water or wet ground, and glowing orange lava or embers in the background.
A lower-left detail panel labeled HEAD CLOSE shows the dragon’s horned head in profile, with layered dark scales and a visible amber-orange eye.
A lower-row panel labeled WING MEMBRANE shows the wing’s dark, leathery membrane stretched between long skeletal wing fingers.
A lower-row panel labeled CLAW AND FOOT shows a heavily scaled foot with large curved claws.
A lower-right panel labeled SCALE DETAIL shows overlapping, ridged dark scales with subtle blue-green iridescence.
The middle-row panels are labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR and show the same dragon from those three viewpoints.

limitations: The inset panels are relatively small, limiting fine anatomical detail beyond what is broadly visible.
